messages:
Maya: Hey infra — requesting GPU quota and EIP increases across two projects for a multi-tenant benchmark cluster. Projects: redwood-bench-01 (proj: 435672901234) and redwood-prod-sim (proj: 435672901799). Need: A100 80GB x4 in us-west1 and L4 x8 in us-east1. Also hit external IP quota in us-west1 (currently 7/8) — request bump to 20 EIPs. Start window: next week. Purpose: full perf/quantization sweep and production-simulated load tests.

Rafael: Can you paste the numeric project IDs and billing account? Also rough monthly GPU hours and cost estimate so we can justify quota.

Maya: Project IDs above. Billing account: BILL-7890-REDWOOD. Rough estimate: A100 4 nodes x 24h x 30d ~= 2880 GPU-hours; L4 8 nodes x 6h/day x 30d ~= 1440 GPU-hours (we'll stage load tests). Estimated monthly bill delta ~ $70k (back-of-envelope) — will refine.

Sam: Quick infra note — do these projects live under the same org folder? If yes, we should use Shared VPC (prod-shared-vpc) so we don't chew EIPs per-project. If they're separate, EIP bump makes sense but we should consider using alias IPs or NAT where possible.

Jules: Network checks: us-east1 L4 rollout may be constrained by egress quota and L4 availability. Also for EIP you need IN_USE_ADDRESSES quota bump in the GCP Quota console. Link to internal quota form: https://go.redwood/infra/gcp-quota-request — please include exact regions, resource types ("N1_EXTERNAL_ADDRESSES"/"IN_USE_ADDRESSES") and justification.

Maya: Adding the exact request payload we submitted to GCP (copied):
```
Project: 435672901234, region: us-west1
resources: ["A100_80GB", "IN_USE_ADDRESSES"]
quota: {"A100_80GB": 4, "IN_USE_ADDRESSES": 20}
reason: "Benchmark suite for quantized compiler tuning and throughput validation; required non-preemptible nodes for stable latency metrics"
```

Rafael: Two follow-ups: 1) Why A100 80GB instead of 40GB? 2) Are these preemptible? Preemptibles reduce cost but may skew perf measurements.

Maya: Need 80GB to host full fp16 + KV cache at seq_len 4096 without OOM; experiments require stable runtime so non-preemptible. Added that rationale to the quota form.

infra-oncall: I can provisionally approve the EIP bump for redwood-bench-01 pending finance OK. Please open an internal cost-approval note for chargeback center.

sre-bot: Created ticket INFRA-2026-783: "GCP quota increase request (A100/L4/IN_USE_ADDRESSES)". Linked: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INFRA-2026-783. Expected GCP response ETA: 48-72h.

gcp-approvals-bot: Automated checks: billing account BILL-7890-REDWOOD attached — OK. Org policy scan: no deny rules for accelerators. Missing: service account role compute.quotaAdmin for the requestor's service account; added as comment on ticket.

Sam: Also flag cost-optimization: can we use L4 preemptibles for the exploratory sweep, then reserve non-preemptible A100s only for final runs? That would cut ~40% cost on the L4 side.

Maya: Plan: L4 preemptible for day experiments, A100 non-preemptible for nightly stable runs. Updated ticket with node pool configs and hours.

Rafael: Finance will want a 3-month projection and estimated peak spend. @infra-oncall please loop finance contact.

infra-oncall: Done — looped finance (cc'd). I approve the SRE-side of this, subject to final finance signoff.

Maya: Thanks all — I've attached the perf targets and throughput numbers to INFRA-2026-783. Will wait for GCP reply, keeping this thread for updates. :thumbsup:
